ex.t: 当我17岁时，我读了一篇关于麦克奈博物馆的杂志文章，这里曾经是一位名叫玛丽安·麦克奈的水彩画家的家。她请求社区在她去世后将它改造成博物馆。在一个晴朗的星期六，萨利和我开车去了博物馆。她问："你有地址吗？""没有，但我能认出来，杂志上有张图片。

ex.s: After you exercise, you continue to burn calories throughout the day.

defs.def: an injury or a mark caused by fire, heat or acid 烧伤；烫伤；灼伤；烧（或烫、灼）的痕迹

ex.s: You also have to wonder at the unique madness of a language in which a house can burn up as it burns down, in which you fill in a form by filling it out, and in which an alarm is only heard once it goes off!
ex.t: 你也不禁要惊叹于一种语言特有的奇妙：房子焚毁既可以说 burn up 也可以说 burn down，填表既说 fill in 也说 fill out，而闹钟只有响起来（go off）才能被听见！

ex.s: Alistair pushed himself towards the finish line in the burning heat, but as he came round the corner, he saw his brother about to fall onto the track.
ex.t: 阿利斯泰尔在炽热中奋力冲向终点线，但转过弯道时，他看见弟弟快要摔倒在跑道上。

ex.s: When a house is destroyed by fire, you can say "it burns up", and you can also say "it burns down".
ex.t: 当房子被火烧毁时，你可以说“it burns up”，也可以说“it burns down”。

ex.s: Even after more than a thousand years have passed, we can still feel the power within its burning eyes, bared teeth and kicking hooves.
ex.t: 即使过了一千多年，我们仍能感受到它燃烧的双目、龇起的牙齿和踢动的蹄子中所蕴含的力量。

defs.def: the feeling that you get in your muscles when you have done a lot of exercise 酸痛感

ex.s: It’s good for your heart and you'll burn a lot of calories without going anywhere!
ex.t: 它对心脏有益，而且你足不出户就能消耗大量卡路里！
